name: YoshisCookieRecomp
summary: Native Yoshi's Cookie recompilation built from the exact original with a pinned Windows recipe.

source_requirements.label: Yoshi's Cookie (USA), exact full NES2 original

presentation.manual_preparation: Register the unchanged exact USA full NES2 original. Core authenticates pinned source/toolchain inputs and builds the fixed v1.1.0 Windows runtime privately. Keep the original header unchanged. Core preserves config.ini, config.ini.tmp, saves/ and root cyc_shot_*.png screenshots. Keep debug.ini absent: it enables an unqualified local TCP interface and is refused before launch. Actual private Core install, verification, old-reader refusal, two startup/ordinary-close/restart cycles, current-release no-change, config backup/restore and consent-bound owned removal passed with the recorded qualification CLI. Another release requires a reviewed compatible recipe; no previous version or successful rollback is qualified. Installed Desktop, protected production delivery, gameplay/save-load, audio/controllers and other platforms remain unqualified. See the owning qualification record for exact evidence scopes.
